reviewSamples.author: Nilso Enrique Negrette Bravo
reviewSamples.text: Excellent work. Their responsibility, attention to detail, and the cleanliness with which they carried out the installation exceeded my expectations. The lamps turned out perfectly, and the final result was impeccable. I recommend them with complete confidence.

reviewSamples.author: Iraida Camacho
reviewSamples.text: I hired Rinca to install the lights in my living room and entryway, and I was 100% satisfied. Duilio was very professional, punctual, and detail-oriented. He also went the extra mile to make sure everything was perfect. I recommend Rinca without hesitation!

reviewSamples.author: Alejandra Matos
reviewSamples.text: I highly recommend this company. They are punctual and very organized. I hired them to hang the TV in my room, and they did it very quickly and left everything clean and tidy. 100% recommended.

reviewSamples.author: Andry Duarte
reviewSamples.text: “I am very satisfied with Rinca LLC's service. They repaired my sliding patio door and also did an excellent job with the pressure washer. They were punctual, professional, and left everything in perfect condition. I definitely recommend them and will hire them again.”
